items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: Charlie Spivak he was at the Rose Pelton not so long ago I think he may still be there as far as I know

ctx.x: has his own band well he's Charlie Spivak man good thing you got a good retentive mind and a memory Charlie Spivak he was at the Rose Pelton not so long ago I think he may still be there as far as I know
